requirements.text: - BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline, with industry experience.
- 3+ years as a software engineer, with proven contributions to team-based, production systems — ideally in a collaborative, multi-disciplinary environment.
- Solid programming skills in C/C++ and/or Python, with a strong grasp of data structures and algorithms.
- Comfort moving across the stack — backend services, user-facing surfaces, instrumentation and tooling — and the engineering rigor to know which trade-offs matter at which layer.
- Strong sense of ownership and a bias for action: you finish what you start, and you ship.
- End-to-end product engineering experience; B2B or enterprise platform experience;
